claims.text: The CNN-based sentence classifier achieved the best results in all three sub-tasks.
The CNN outperforms the RNN model, achieving a macro-F1 score of 0.80.
The CNN system achieved higher performance compared to the BiLSTM, with a macro-F1 score of 0.69.
